Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning. Quick recap and the next steps I promised:

- Current priority: reduce inference cost for chat-heavy features while keeping p95 latency under 200ms.
- Data concerns: must remain in-region (US) and no user content exported to external analytics.
- Success metric: <15% token cost reduction without >5% quality delta on core prompts.

Next steps (technical deep dive with infra + product):
1) 30-minute walkthrough with our runtime engineer to validate latency profiling and KV cache options.
2) Align on measurement plan and a small pilot (10M tokens/month).

I have two tightly-held slots this week for the deep dive (we're balancing several enterprise requests):
- Option A: Monday 2027-12-06 09:00–09:30 PT
- Option B: Tuesday 2027-12-07 14:00–14:30 PT

Please reply with the single option that works for you by EOD Friday (2027-12-03). If we don't hear back by then, we'll release the slots and propose next availability the following week.

Attached is a short technical brief and a draft mutual action plan to speed approvals.

Thanks — I know schedules are tight, appreciate a one-line confirm.
